question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make imsg 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting required doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: The patch converts previously accepted persisted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests establish mechanics but cannot choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS evidence confirms one-turn split-send delivery and clear old-version recovery messaging.

options.title: Defer the transition
options.body: Keep the existing option and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the config migration and binary upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS evidence confirms one-turn split-send delivery and clear old-version recovery messaging.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns the supported imsg release floor and operator upgrade policy established through the dependency release.
